headline: SAP confirms hackers copied source code as breaches hit the Air Force, FIFA, and a password manager.

emerging_trends.text: Attackers keep poisoning trusted software channels, tampering with Q-Dir installers on the vendor's own site after copying SAP source code from hijacked GitHub accounts.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Attackers Trojanize Signed Windows Utility Downloads

emerging_trends.text: Switzerland's confirmation that AI agents breached critical infrastructure operators shows autonomous tooling like ARTEX moving from research demos into state-linked intrusion campaigns.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Switzerland Confirms AI Agents Breached Operators

emerging_trends.text: Breaches at Cloud One, the FBI, the CIA, and Japan's education ministry show government platforms absorbing a sustained wave of intrusions this month.

topics.title: Breaches Hit Flight Centre, myColorado, and Japan Ministry
topics.latest_developments: Boston Scientific started notifying people whose personal and medical information attackers exposed in a cyberattack on the medical technology company.
topics.why_it_matters: Passport, medical, and government identification records fuel identity fraud for years, and no password reset undoes their theft.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: Flight Centre Travel Group told the Australian Securities Exchange that intruders reached customer names and, in rare cases, passport and health details through a third-party booking system.

details.label: By the numbers
details.text: Hackers breached the myColorado digital identification application and accessed user-uploaded data, potentially affecting 100,000 people.

details.label: The big picture
details.text: Japan's education ministry said hackers breached its government procurement system, potentially exposing business information and email addresses.

sources.title: New Boston Scientific data breach exposes personal, medical info
Flight Centre Travel Group warns of customer data breach involving some passport details
100,000 Potentially Impacted by Colorado Data Breach
Japan's education ministry discloses breach of government procurement system

topics.title: SAP Confirms Attackers Copied Source Code
topics.latest_developments: SAP confirmed suspicious GitHub activity in its information technology environment, and reports say hackers used stolen employee tokens to copy and alter source code.
topics.why_it_matters: SAP software runs finance and logistics for most large enterprises, so altered code raises the risk of poisoned updates reaching customers.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Rotate GitHub tokens and move developer accounts to short-lived credentials. Track SAP advisories for named repositories and affected builds.

details.label: Flashback
details.text: The case echoes the 1Password breach, where an attacker hijacked an employee's corporate GitHub account and copied private repository code.

sources.title: SAP confirms security incident after suspicious GitHub activity
SAP Confirms Cyberattack, Source Code Reportedly Compromised
Software giant SAP confirms cyber incident amid reports of source code breach

topics.title: Researchers Detail Cacti and Linux Root Flaws
topics.latest_developments: A public proof-of-concept exploit for the Cacti zero-day 4HTTP2SHELL now gives unauthenticated attackers command execution, and no patch or CVE identifier exists yet.
topics.why_it_matters: Cacti monitors network devices with broad credentials, and the separate Linux Network File System bug CVE-2026-99362 hands remote attackers root on file servers.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Disable guest access in Cacti and pull the interface off the internet. Patch Linux kernels on every host exporting NFS shares.

details.label: Flashback
details.text: The Network File System flaw sat in the kernel for 12 years before researchers disclosed it this week.

sources.title: Unpatched Cacti zero-day with public PoC gives remote code execution
Unpatched Cacti Zero-Day Enables RCE in Just Four HTTP Requests via Guest Access
New NFS2ROOT Linux flaw can let attackers gain root privileges

topics.title: FIFA and AFP Confirm Separate Cyberattacks
topics.latest_developments: FIFA said hackers accessed a limited set of personal and business information, and Agence France-Presse took a main news distribution platform offline after a Thursday attack.
topics.why_it_matters: Agence France-Presse feeds stories to media worldwide, so the outage stalls newsrooms, and FIFA holds data on players, staff, and commercial partners.

details.label: What to watch
details.text: FIFA, based in Zurich, has not said when the attack happened or what the intruders took. It is working with law enforcement.

sources.title: FIFA hacked, cybercriminals claim access to sensitive internal records
FIFA Says It Has Been Victim of a Cyberattack Accessing 'Personal and Business Information'
Cyberattack disrupts global news distribution platform at France's AFP

topics.title: Drupal Flags Second Exploited Takeover Flaw
topics.latest_developments: CISA added exploited Drupal core flaw CVE-2026-136716 and two OSGeo GeoServer flaws, CVE-2026-120705 and CVE-2026-129243, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog Friday.
topics.why_it_matters: Site owners who already fixed the Fail2Install bug stay exposed, and a hijacked content management system hands attackers the whole web server.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Install the newest Drupal core security release now and treat internet-facing sites as compromised. CISA's deadline for CVE-2026-132165 hit November 27, 2026.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: The Drupal security team says attackers are exploiting a second critical access bypass flaw to breach and hijack unpatched websites.

sources.title: Drupal warns of new site takeover flaw exploited in attacks
CISA Adds Three Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog

topics.title: Switzerland Confirms AI Agents Breached Operators
topics.latest_developments: Switzerland's cybersecurity agency said attackers using AI agents broke in during four of five confirmed cases, including two successful intrusions at critical infrastructure operators.
topics.why_it_matters: Agent-driven attacks now land on infrastructure operators, shrinking the time defenders get between initial access and damage.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: Three of the five attacks targeted critical infrastructure operators. The agency reported no major disruptions and named neither the victims nor the attackers.

details.label: Between the lines
details.text: Microsoft Threat Intelligence says China- and North Korea-linked state groups now run ARTEX, the open-source framework whose agents plan and execute attacks.

sources.title: Switzerland Confirms AI-Assisted Cyberattacks Breached Critical Infrastructure Operators
Chinese and North Korean state hackers add ARTEX AI framework to their arsenal

topics.title: Attackers Trojanize Signed Windows Utility Downloads
topics.latest_developments: Researchers found tampered Q-Dir and DesktopOK installers on the official SoftwareOK website, and eSentire traced a Microsoft-signed Snipping-Tool.exe installer that delivered Vinci RAT.
topics.why_it_matters: Trusted vendor download pages and valid Microsoft signatures defeat the checks users and allowlists rely on, handing attackers remote control of workstations.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: SoftwareOK served malicious files during updates of already installed programs. The Vinci RAT chain began with a redirect to the fake site snipp.codes-team[.]com.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Reinstall Q-Dir and DesktopOK from verified copies. Hunt for Snipping-Tool.exe executions and traffic to the fake sniping tool domain.

sources.title: Hackers Trojanize Official Q-Dir and DesktopOK Downloads to Deliver Remote Access Malware
Microsoft Store App Found Delivering Vinci RAT Capable of Remote System Control

topics.title: Hackers Reportedly Breach Air Force Cloud One
topics.latest_developments: Hackers reportedly breached Cloud One, the United States Air Force computing platform, extending a wave of intrusions at the FBI, CIA, and Treasury Department.
topics.why_it_matters: Cloud One hosts Air Force applications, so a compromise there could expose military data and reach systems across many service programs.

details.label: What to watch
details.text: The Air Force has not confirmed the breach, named the attackers, or said what data they reached.

sources.title: US Air Force cloud platform reportedly hacked in latest federal breach

topics.title: pCloud Confirms Password Manager Hack
topics.latest_developments: pCloud confirmed a cyberattack on its pCloud Pass password manager after users reported unknown devices connecting to accounts that had two-factor authentication turned on.
topics.why_it_matters: A password manager holds every other credential, so attackers who reach those vaults can walk into banking, email, and corporate accounts.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Change the pCloud account password, revoke every unrecognized device session, and rotate the credentials stored inside pCloud Pass.

sources.title: pCloud confirms password manager hack after suspicious login alerts

topics.title: Justice Department Charges 800 Alleged Scammers
topics.latest_developments: The Department of Justice charged more than 800 alleged scammers across 400 cases in 85 federal districts and seized nearly $17 billion.
topics.why_it_matters: Fraud rings that drain consumer and corporate accounts now face extradition and asset seizure, raising the cost of running offshore call centers.

details.label: By the numbers
details.text: Prosecutors extradited 30 defendants. American agents joined police in more than 10 countries to raid scam call centers and compounds abroad.

sources.title: US seizes nearly $17 billion in global war on scam rings

business_politics.title: S&P Cuts France Outlook to Negative
business_politics.latest_developments: S&P Global Ratings revised France's credit outlook to negative from stable Friday, November 27, citing political instability that makes closing the public deficit harder.
business_politics.why_it_matters: The move opens the path to a downgrade of a core eurozone sovereign, repricing French government bonds held across bank and insurer balance sheets.

details.label: Between the lines
details.text: Far-left presidential candidate Jean-Luc Mélenchon escalated his attacks on Germany at a Berlin campaign stop, underscoring the political turbulence S&P flagged.

sources.title: S&P cuts France outlook to negative
S&P Revises Outlook on France's Credit Rating to Negative From Stable
Mélenchon takes aim at Germany in Berlin campaign stop

business_politics.title: Citigroup Ousts Executives Over Risk Error
business_politics.latest_developments: Citigroup is removing several London-based executives after undercounting $35 billion in risk-weighted assets, and a senior risk official now runs the cleanup from the trading hub.
business_politics.why_it_matters: The shake-up puts Chief Executive Jane Fraser's control overhaul back under regulatory scrutiny at one of the largest United States banks.

details.label: Flashback
details.text: The Wall Street Journal first reported the undercount at Citigroup's United Kingdom subsidiary on Friday, November 20.

sources.title: Citigroup's $35 Billion Bookkeeping Snafu Sparks Shake-Up in Upper Ranks

business_politics.title: U.S. Strikes Ship Running Iran Blockade
business_politics.latest_developments: United States forces struck a vessel attempting a blockade run near Iran, the Wall Street Journal reported Friday, November 27, as diplomatic talks with Tehran stalled.
business_politics.why_it_matters: President Trump's squeeze on Iran's economy raises escalation risk around the Strait of Hormuz, where tanker traffic and war-risk insurance costs already run high.

sources.title: U.S. Strikes Vessel Attempting Blockade Run Near Iran

business_politics.title: Cyberattacks Knock Western Agencies Offline
business_politics.latest_developments: The United Kingdom Department for Work and Pensions took most of its online services offline Friday, November 27, after a suspected cyberattack, joining FIFA and the United States Treasury.
business_politics.why_it_matters: Millions of United Kingdom benefit claimants lose online access, and the Financial Times said a widening attack wave on western institutions now draws on artificial intelligence.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: Allstate joined the list of companies hit by technology outages. The multiday failure left customers unable to reach the insurer during one of the year's busiest travel weeks.

sources.title: UK Department for Work and Pensions hit by cyber incident
Wave of cyber incidents rattles western economies
Allstate Joins Growing List of Companies Hit by Tech Outages

business_politics.title: France Slips Into Recession as Exports Sag
business_politics.latest_developments: France's economy shrank 0.2% in the third quarter, worse than first estimated, tipping the eurozone's second-largest economy into recession as summer heat waves slowed Airbus factories.
business_politics.why_it_matters: A French recession strains already stressed public finances and weakens the case for further European Central Bank tightening.

details.label: By the numbers
details.text: Inflation fell more than expected in November in France and Spain on cheaper fuel. Eurozone third-quarter growth also came in below earlier estimates.

sources.title: France Slips Into Recession as Exports Sag
French economy shrinks 0.2% in third quarter
Inflation Slides in France, Spain on Declining Fuel Prices

business_politics.title: Global Stocks Rebound as Beijing Pledges Support
business_politics.latest_developments: The Nasdaq composite closed its best week since April on Friday, November 27, after Beijing vowed stabilization policies and China's CSI 300 posted its biggest one-day gain in two years.
business_politics.why_it_matters: The bounce pauses a selloff that drove United States technology stocks into a bear market, easing margin and liquidity pressure across portfolios.

details.label: By the numbers
details.text: Gold and silver rallied as risk appetite returned. All three major United States indexes ended the shortened post-Thanksgiving week higher, and Treasury yields moved up as the dollar strengthened.

details.label: Yes, but
details.text: The Wall Street Journal argued President Trump cannot rescue the market, and that engineering Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia left the underlying earnings uncertainty untouched.

sources.title: Stock Futures Jump as AI Trade Set for Rebound

Precious Metals Rally as AI Trade Revives Risk Appetite

business_politics.title: Oil Tops $97 Before OPEC+ Meeting
business_politics.latest_developments: Crude futures settled lower Friday, November 27, in light Black Friday trading as traders waited for Sunday's OPEC+ meeting on 2027 output policy.
business_politics.why_it_matters: Energy costs feed the inflation picture as the Federal Reserve weighs a December rate increase, and Gulf shipping risk lifts freight and insurance bills.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: Dubai's benchmark stock index erased its wartime losses, passing its February 27 closing level and gaining nearly 14% this month as bank and property shares rose.

business.title: Toomey Says GOP Abandoned Economic Freedom
business.latest_developments: Former United States Senator Pat Toomey of Pennsylvania argued Friday, November 27, that Republicans have lost their way on economic policy and must return to free-market roots.
business.why_it_matters: Toomey warned the party "risks making its minority status permanent" in Washington, a critique aimed at the tariffs and industrial policy now setting business costs.

details.label: The big picture
details.text: A separate TribLive column by S.E. Cupp published Friday said Republicans should cut President Trump loose after the 2026 midterm losses.

sources.title: Former U.S. Sen. Pat Toomey: 'Is the GOP still a party of economic freedom?'

business.title: Uniontown Shoppers Line Up for NeeDoh
business.latest_developments: Shoppers waited hours in the cold in Uniontown Friday, November 27, for an exclusive Black Friday drop of the NeeDoh squeeze toy, KDKA's Lauren Linder reported.
business.why_it_matters: Scarce toy releases still pull Fayette County buyers into stores in person, even as most holiday discounting moves online.

sources.title: Uniontown shoppers brave Black Friday cold for exclusive NeeDoh toy release

business.title: Record Black Friday Spending Defies Inflation
business.latest_developments: Shoppers queued before sunrise at Macy's Friday, November 27, and weeks of discounts are driving record Black Friday spending despite inflation concerns, TribLive reported.
business.why_it_matters: Holiday demand holding up gives retailers room to protect margins, even as shoppers absorb higher prices and storms disrupt travel and parades.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: Pittsburgh-area shoppers braved cold and rain Friday morning, setting early alarms and lining up for deals, WPXI reported.

sources.title: Weeks of hot deals are encouraging record Black Friday spending despite inflation concerns
Pittsburgh shoppers brave cold and rain for Black Friday Deals

business.title: AI Shopping Agents Steer Buyers to Fakes
business.latest_developments: KDKA reported Friday, November 27, that artificial-intelligence shopping bots are steering Black Friday buyers toward fake online stores scammers built with the same technology.
business.why_it_matters: A shopper who hands holiday purchases to an agent can give card details to a storefront that never ships anything.

sources.title: Your AI shopping agent may not spot a fake online store this Black Friday

business.title: Majors Management Buys 22 Sweet Pea's Stores
business.latest_developments: Majors Management LLC has bought 22 Sweet Pea's retail locations serving Allegheny, Beaver, Butler, Fayette, and Westmoreland counties, WPXI reported Friday, November 27.
business.why_it_matters: One operator now runs every Sweet Pea's store in the region, putting workers and regular shoppers in five counties under new management.

sources.title: Majors Management LLC buys 22 Sweet Pea's locations in Western Pennsylvania

business.title: Editorial Defends LIHEAP as Winter Arrives
business.latest_developments: A TribLive editorial published Friday, November 27, said more than 300,000 Pennsylvania households depend on the Low-Income Home Energy Assistance Program to heat their homes.
business.why_it_matters: Cash benefits run from $200 to $1,000 per household, money that keeps utility shutoffs and unpaid fuel bills off family budgets.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: A crisis grant program can add up to $1,000 more for emergencies such as an empty fuel tank or a broken furnace.

sources.title: Editorial: LIHEAP does more than warm hearts

around_town.title: Pirates Trade Henry Davis to Arizona
around_town.latest_developments: The Pittsburgh Pirates traded catcher Henry Davis, the No. 1 overall pick in the 2021 draft, to the Arizona Diamondbacks for infielder and outfielder Tim Tawa.
around_town.why_it_matters: The deal ends Pittsburgh's five-year wait for a franchise cornerstone behind the plate and opens the club's offseason roster rebuild.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: Davis, 27, never lived up to his reputation as a top college hitter, TribLive reported. The trade is the Pirates' first notable move of the offseason.

sources.title: Pirates trade former No. 1 overall pick Henry Davis to Diamondbacks for IF/OF Tim Tawa
Pirates trade Henry Davis to Diamondbacks
Pirates reportedly trading former first-overall pick Henry Davis to Arizona

around_town.title: Ligonier Township Taps Reserves for 2027
around_town.latest_developments: Ligonier Township will vote next month on a proposed 2027 budget carrying a shortfall of about $124,300 that officials plan to cover from reserves, TribLive reported Friday, November 27.
around_town.why_it_matters: Drawing down savings closes the gap for one year and leaves the township thinner cushion for storms and equipment costs ahead.

sources.title: Ligonier Township plans to tap reserves to cover 2027 budget

around_town.title: Gilpin Supervisors Weigh a Local Service Tax
around_town.latest_developments: Gilpin supervisors are considering a new local service tax for the Armstrong County township, TribLive reported Friday, November 27.
around_town.why_it_matters: A local service tax would take a flat levy from the paychecks of people who work in Gilpin, including residents of other municipalities.

sources.title: Gilpin supervisors to consider a local service tax

around_town.title: Light of Life Serves 1,200 Thanksgiving Meals
around_town.latest_developments: Light of Life Rescue Mission prepared more than 1,200 Thanksgiving meals for people in need, KDKA reported Friday, November 27.
around_town.why_it_matters: The meals reached Pittsburgh-area residents who had no holiday table of their own.

sources.title: Light of Life Rescue Mission prepares more than 1,200 Thanksgiving meals for those in need

around_town.title: Analysis Prices a $60,000 Teacher Minimum
around_town.latest_developments: A NewsWorks Lab analysis published by TribLive Friday, November 27, estimated the cost of a $60,000 minimum salary for Pennsylvania teachers using state education records.
around_town.why_it_matters: Pay floors drive district budgets and hiring power, and the lowest-paying districts would absorb the steepest increases.

details.label: By the numbers
details.text: Harmony Area School District, spanning Clearfield and Indiana counties, pays the state's lowest median teacher salary at $41,750, roughly $18,000 under the proposed floor.

sources.title: What would it cost to set a $60K minimum salary for Pa. teachers?

around_town.title: Hempfield Buys House Near Founders Park
around_town.latest_developments: Hempfield will pay $100,000 for a house near Founders Park and use the property as buffer space, TribLive reported Friday, November 27.
around_town.why_it_matters: The township gains control of land abutting its main park, heading off future friction between park activity and the neighboring lot.

sources.title: Hempfield to buy a $100,000 home near Founders Park to use as buffer space

around_town.title: Rain, Wind, and Snow Linger Into Friday
around_town.latest_developments: WTAE declared a second Impact Day for Friday, November 27, with rain, wind, and snow showers in the Laurel Highlands trailing Thursday's Thanksgiving storm.
around_town.why_it_matters: Black Friday shoppers and returning holiday travelers across Western Pennsylvania face wet roads, gusts, and slick spots at higher elevations.

details.label: What's next
details.text: Rain and snow showers taper Friday night. Saturday turns mainly dry and breezy, and showers return Sunday evening, WTAE and WPXI reported.

details.label: By the numbers
details.text: Thursday's system delivered the Pittsburgh region's second-wettest Thanksgiving on record, WPXI meteorologist Adis Juklo said, without setting an all-time mark.

events.title: Brady's Run Christmas Tree Festival Returns
events.latest_developments: The Brady's Run Christmas Tree Festival has returned after a one-year hiatus with 43 trees, each decorated on a different theme, WPXI reported Friday, November 27.
events.why_it_matters: Visitors get back a walk-through holiday display that organizers skipped last year.

sources.title: Brady's Run Christmas Tree Festival returns after one-year hiatus

events.title: Pittsburgh Zoo Revives Holiday Lights Drive-Thru
events.latest_developments: The Pittsburgh Zoo reopens its Holiday Lights drive-thru Friday evening, November 27, for the first time since 2023, WPXI reported.
events.why_it_matters: Families get back a car-bound holiday outing the zoo shelved for three years, with no walking required in cold, wet weather.

details.label: When
details.text: Opening night is Friday evening, November 27.

details.label: Where
details.text: Pittsburgh Zoo, in Pittsburgh's Highland Park neighborhood.

sources.title: Holiday Lights drive-thru returns to Pittsburgh Zoo after three years

events.title: Guide Maps 18 Holiday Pop-Up Bars
events.latest_developments: TribLive published a guide Friday, November 27, to 18 Pittsburgh-area holiday pop-up bars, including immersive rooms, tropical escapes, and a visit from Krampus.
events.why_it_matters: Anyone planning holiday nights out gets one current list of themed bars open now across the region.

sources.title: From Krampus to Christmas kitsch: A guide to Pittsburgh's holiday pop-up bars

events.title: TribLive Maps Regional Christmas Light Displays
events.latest_developments: TribLive published a guide Friday, November 27, to Christmas light displays across Pittsburgh and Western Pennsylvania, with dozens of sites already open to visitors.
events.why_it_matters: Families planning a holiday weekend outing get one current list of displays running now around the region.

sources.title: Where to see Christmas lights in Pittsburgh and Western Pa. in 2026

around_teams.title: McCarthy and Rudolph Face Media After Broncos
around_teams.latest_developments: Head coach Mike McCarthy, quarterback Mason Rudolph, T.J. Watt, and Cameron Heyward took questions after the Steelers' Week 12 game against the Denver Broncos, the team posted Friday, November 27.
around_teams.why_it_matters: The news conference marks the first time this group addressed reporters after a game since the Steelers released Aaron Rodgers on November 25.

details.label: Flashback
details.text: Rudolph had met the media Wednesday, November 25, in his first session as the Steelers' starting quarterback for the Black Friday matchup.

team_usa.title: Malinin Leads NHK Trophy After Personal Best
team_usa.latest_developments: American Ilia Malinin took the lead at the NHK Trophy Friday, November 27, with a personal-best short program, ESPN reported.
team_usa.why_it_matters: The skate moves Malinin closer to a Grand Prix Final berth and another title shot against the circuit's best men.

sources.title: Malinin takes NHK Trophy lead with personal best in short program

team_usa.title: USWNT Can Clinch World Cup Berth Friday
team_usa.latest_developments: The United States women's national team meets El Salvador Friday, November 27, at the Concacaf W Championship, where a win seals its 2027 Women's World Cup place.
team_usa.why_it_matters: Victory ends the qualifying question for Emma Hayes's team, which ESPN said has no excuses in this competition.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: Midfielder Sam Coffey called her return to the squad surreal after injuries kept her out of recent major matches for the United States.

USWNT's Coffey grateful for 'surreal' return for Women's World Cup qualifying

team_usa.title: Olympic Rower Anita DeFrantz Dies at 74
team_usa.latest_developments: Anita DeFrantz, the American bronze-medal Olympic rower who became a trailblazing advocate for women in Olympic policymaking, died at 74, ESPN reported Thursday, November 26.
team_usa.why_it_matters: DeFrantz spent decades pressing for women's access to Olympic leadership, work that shaped how the movement's governing bodies operate.

sources.title: Olympic rower DeFrantz, trailblazing advocate for women, dies at 74
